# regs: which central-column row is which register. Follow tasks from sel / bd3's tracks.
# Piece 1: the write strobes of R12, R13, R14, R15 from where bd3 leaves them (y 17300)
# to the write lines of the rows they strobe. No transistors.
@block regs
@w M=12 P=18
@s 26x26

# --- wr_r12: T7's line -> row y 17302 -> cdp3's row C write line (cdp3_c_wr) ----------
M 15214,17290 y17302 x14714 w=14
P 14697,17285:14731,17319            # pad east of the supply rail
C 14714,17302
P 14714,17302 x14497                 # under trunks' X and the VCC rail x 14584-14634
P 14480,17285:14514,17319
C 14497,17302
M 14497,17302 x13386 w=14
P 13369,17285:13403,17319
C 13386,17302
P 13386,17302 x12805                 # under the vertical trunks
P 12788,17285:12822,17319
C 12805,17302
M 12805,17303 x11463 y14785 x11376 y11905
N M 11463,16000 wr_r12
# y 11757-11905: the full-width metal stops at both ends; between them both metal shots
# show only a thin bright line (x 11370-11380) over a load-like unit that is not drawn
# (notes, Ambiguities 1). Drawn uncertain.
?M 11376,11905 y11757 w=8
M 11376,11757 11375,10688 10938,10251 10938,9532
P 10918,9515:10952,9549              # pad at the east end of row C's write line
C 10935,9532
P 10835,9533 x10935 w=20
@alias wr_r12 cdp3_c_wr

N M 11418,16000 wr_r14
P 10876,8802:10910,8836
C 10893,8819
P 10835,8818 x10893 w=16
@alias wr_r14 cdp3_l8819
